turns.patient_response: I’ve been struggling with these repetitive behaviors that I feel like I have to do over and over, even when I know they don’t really make sense. They’re taking up a lot of my time and making it hard to get through my day, and I’m finding it really hard to control them.

symptom_reasoning.S066: The patient describes repetitive behaviors they feel compelled to perform despite recognizing they are not logical, finding them hard to control and time-consuming, which is characteristic of compulsions.
